glossary.definition: (1) "Agricultural production" has the same meaning as in section 929.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 901.80 - Immunity from liability for agritourism providers.

glossary.definition: (2) "Agritourism" means an agriculturally related educational, entertainment, historical, cultural, or recreational activity, including you-pick operations or farm markets, conducted on a farm that allows or invites members of the general public to observe, participate in, or enjoy that activity.
glossary.source_title: Section 901.80 - Immunity from liability for agritourism providers.

glossary.definition: (3) "Agritourism provider" means a person who owns, operates, provides, or sponsors an agritourism activity or an employee of such a person who engages in or provides agritourism activities whether or not for a fee.
glossary.source_title: Section 901.80 - Immunity from liability for agritourism providers.

glossary.definition: (4) "Farm" means land that is composed of tracts, lots, or parcels totaling not less than ten acres devoted to agricultural production or totaling less than ten acres devoted to agricultural production if the land produces an average yearly gross income of at least twenty-five hundred dollars from agricultural production.
glossary.source_title: Section 901.80 - Immunity from liability for agritourism providers.

glossary.definition: (5) "Participant" means an individual, other than an agritourism provider, who observes or participates in an agritourism activity.
glossary.source_title: Section 901.80 - Immunity from liability for agritourism providers.

glossary.normalized: risk inherent in an agritourism activity
